title: CEI for SR 5 St. Johns River Bridge
short_description: Construction engineering inspection services for a highway bridge project in Jacksonville, Florida.
project_scope: Construction Engineering Inspection (CEI) services for State Road 5 (US 1 / Main Street) at St. Johns River Bridge No. 720022. The notice identifies a bridge project with a stated contract value of 23.2 million USD, but provides no technical bridge characteristics such as span lengths, structural system, rehabilitation scope, or dimensions.
services: Construction engineering inspection services; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, materials testing, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- The tender is primarily for construction engineering inspection, not core structural design.
- It concerns a road bridge, which is generally relevant to sbp, but no special structural features or large-span information are provided.
- Requested structural engineering discipline suggests some technical bridge involvement, but the main scope remains inspection and construction support.
- Presence of construction/project management and materials testing further indicates limited direct design opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value: 23.2 million USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee is stated. The notice is for CEI services only; no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the limited information.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, materials testing, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
